blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Single-document LoRA adapters have been proposed as units of knowledge to be merged and retrieved; yet open-book scoring, with the document in the prompt, can credit a document's own adapter (its specialist) for reading that document as readily as for holding it. Training one adapter for each of 150 Wikipedia articles on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, we find that open-book scores mostly measure a reading behaviour every adapter shares: a random adapter trained on another document recovers 82 % of the specialist's open-book advantage over the base model but only 2 % of its advantage on a cloze probe that asks for the same document's facts without providing the source text, a share we cannot distinguish from zero. Content does reach the weights, since the specialists beat the base model in cloze recall by 0.094, and the geometry of their updates follows the documents they read; yet, in a test of 30 queries, adapters chosen by weight-space proximity or text embedding are not distinguishable from random ones on either probe, although that test cannot exclude an advantage of about four fifths of what a query's own adapter gains over a random one. At 16 documents or more, correctly scaled merges recover 87 % to 89 % of the specialists' open-book advantage but only 12 % to 16 % of their cloze advantage, with intervals that run from below zero to at most 32 %, against 94 % for joint training.We also report four silent errors, each of which produced a clean, wrong result.
blocks.zh: 单文件 LORA适配器被提议作为需要合并和检索的知识单位;然而,随着文件的及时性,打开的书籍评分可以归功于文件本身的适配器(其专家)阅读该文件的方便程度和持有程度。 对于150篇维基百科文章中每篇关于Llama-3.1-8B-Instructionct的训练一个适配器,我们发现开本得分大多是衡量每个适配器股份的阅读行为:一个随机适配器在另一个文档上训练了82%的专家开本优势在基模型上恢复,但是在一个块状探测器上只有2%的优势要求同一文档的事实而不提供源文本,这个共享我们无法与零区分. 内容确实到达了权重,因为专家以0.094击败了丁字塔中的基础模型,其更新的几何学遵循了他们读到的文档;然而,在30个查询的测试中,以权重空间相近或文本嵌入方式选择的适配器与两个探测器上的随机适配器是无法区分的,尽管该测试不能排除一个查询自身适配器比随机适配器获得的约五分之四的优势. 在16份文件或以上,正确的合并恢复了87%至89%的专家的开放图书优势,但只有12%至16%的专家的血凝胶优势,其间隔从零以下到最多32%,而联合培训为94%。 我们还报告了四个沉默错误,每个错误都产生了一个干净、错误的结果。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Low-rank adaptation (LoRA; Hu et al., 2022 ) makes fine-tuning cheap enough that adapters can be imagined as a storage medium, one per document, kept in a bank and merged ( Ilharco et al., 2023 ; Yadav et al., 2023 ) or retrieved ( Su et al., 2025 ; Back et al., 2026 ) as a task requires.
What such a bank is worth depends on what its adapters hold; yet scoring them open-book, with the document in the prompt as in the variant of parametric retrieval-augmented generation that Tang et al. (2025b) find strongest, cannot tell an adapter that holds the document’s content from one that has learned to extract answers from whatever text it is given: we find that it mostly measures the second.
To separate the two, on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Llama Team, 2024 ) , we change which adapter answers a fixed document in place of its own specialist, and we employ a cloze probe that states each held-out fact as a sentence with one blank — without the document and in a surface form that no adapter was trained on ( section 2 ).
blocks.zh:
低等级的适应(LORA;Hu等人,2022年)使微调变得非常便宜,可以想象适配器是一个存储介质,每份文件一个,保存在银行里并合并(Ilharco等人,2023年;Yadav等人,2023年)或检索(Su等人,2025年;Back等人,2026年)作为任务需要.
这样的银行的价值取决于它的适配器持有什么;然而,用Tang等人(2025年b)认为最强的参数检索加载生成的变体,即刻将文件评为开放的书,却不能告诉持有文件内容的适配器从已经学会从它给出的任何文本中提取答案的文本中得知:我们发现它大多是衡量第二的。
为了将两者分开,在Llama-3.1-8B-Instructionct(Llama Team,2024年)上,我们更改了哪个适配器回答一个固定文件,以代替自己的专家,我们使用一个凝胶探测器,将每个挡住的事实作为空白的句子——没有文件,而且表面没有训练适配器(第2节)。

blocks.en:
Holding each document’s training questions fixed and varying the text trained beside them ( section 3.1 ), we find that an adapter trained on the questions without the text comes second of five training conditions when scored open-book, yet on cloze it recalls 0.132 0.132 less of the document than the base model does; a cloze gain clear of zero appears exactly where an adapter read the scored document’s full text, and the specialists’ gain over the base model is 0.094 0.094 .
The weights record the same variable: distances between updates sort adapters by domain ( section 3.2 ) and, when an adapter’s questions and text come from different documents, follow the text rather than the questions ( section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh:
将每个文件的培训问题固定下来,并修改旁边培训的文本(第3.1节),我们发现,在没有文本的情况下培训过的问题的适配器在打分的开本时,在五个培训条件中排在第二位,然而,它只记得比基准模型少0.1320.132;在适配器读到文件全文的地方,一个明显的零增长出现,专家对基准模型的收益为0.0940.094。
权重记录了相同的变量:按域排列的更新排序适配器之间的距离(第3.2节),当适配器的问题和文本来自不同的文档时,遵循文本而不是问题(第3.3节).

blocks.en:
Open-book scores follow something else.
An adapter applied to another article of its own domain recovers 88 % 88\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of the open-book advantage that the specialist holds over the base model ( section 4.1 ), and pooled over collections of 16 16 documents or more, a random adapter from outside the collection recovers 82 % 82\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of the specialist’s open-book advantage and 2 % 2\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of its cloze advantage, with a confidence interval that includes zero ( section 4.2 ).
In a bank that never holds the query’s own adapter, an adapter chosen by weight-space proximity is not distinguishable from a random one on either probe, nor is one chosen by text embedding, although with 30 30 queries the cloze confidence interval still admits an advantage of about four fifths of what the query’s own adapter gains over a random one ( section 4.3 ).

blocks.en:
Composition shows the same split ( section 5 ): at four documents or more, merges keep 0.93 to 1.01 0.931.01 of the specialists’ open-book score against 0.88 to 0.97 0.880.97 for random, but at 16 16 documents or more they recover 12 % to 16 % 12\text{\,}\mathrm{\%}16\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of the cloze advantage, each confidence interval including zero, where joint training recovers 94 % 94\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} .
Open-book scores thus overstate how much of a document’s content survives merging or substitution.

blocks.en: Each of four silent errors produced clean results we were prepared to report ( section 6 ): ( a ) a training-length default that reversed a comparison between training conditions; ( b ) a repetition penalty left in our evaluation code; ( c ) a scaling error in our merge, which looked like a cost of merging; and ( d ) an evaluation precision unlike the one the adapters were trained on.
blocks.zh: 我们准备报告的四个无声错误都产生了干净的结果(第6节):(a) 培训时间的缺省,扭转了对培训条件的比较;(b) 我们评价代码中留下的重复处罚;(c) 我们合并中的缩放错误,看来是合并的成本;以及(d) 与适配器所训练的精确评价。

blocks.en: 2 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 2 实验设置

blocks.en:
We use 150 150 Wikipedia articles in English ( Wikimedia Foundation, 2026 ) , 25 25 from each of biology, computer science, economics, history, law, and medicine.
For each article Claude Sonnet 4.6 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) generated 12 12 question-answering pairs, each validated by string match against the source text; eight are used for training, and four (three factual questions and one true/false item) are held out for evaluation.
The base model is Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Llama Team, 2024 ; Meta Llama, 2024a ) , loaded in 4 4 -bit NF4 with bf16 computation as in QLoRA ( Dettmers et al., 2023 ) ; adapters of rank 8 8 on all seven projection matrices train for 500 500 steps with next-token cross-entropy on every token of the training string (instruction, document, question, and answer), capped at 2048 2048 tokens, which fits every training example.
The geometry of section 3 is replicated with the same hyper-parameters on three other models; section A.1 gives the rest of the configuration.
blocks.zh:
我们使用英语的150篇150篇维基百科文章(维基媒体基金会,2026年),25篇来自生物学,计算机科学,经济学,历史,法学,医学各有25篇.
每条 Claude Sonnet 4.6(Anthropic,2026年)共产生12对12个问答对,每对问答对应于源文本进行字符串匹配验证;8对用于训练,4对(3个事实问题和1个真/假项目)被保留出来进行评价.
基准型号为Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct(Llama Team,2024;Meta Llama,2024a),装入4 4-位NF4,并按QLORA(Dettmers等人,2023年)计算bf16;所有7辆投影矩阵列车的适配器为8 8级,500步,每节训练弦(指令,文档,问答)的每个标语上都有次托肯交叉交替,封号为2048 2048令牌,这与每个训练实例相适应.
3节的几何学在另外三个模型上用相同的超参数复制;A.1节给出了其余的配置.

blocks.en: Each document’s question-answering pairs are held fixed, while the text trained beside them (generated by Claude Sonnet 4.6 from the prompts of appendix B ) varies, resulting in five conditions: ( a ) the natural article; ( b ) a style-normalized rewrite into neutral prose; ( c ) a synthetic fill-in-the-blank template that keeps six extracted facts; ( d ) no context , which omits the document text; and ( e ) swapped context , including another article’s prose beside this article’s questions. When no condition is explicitly named, the adapter is trained on the natural article.

blocks.en:
Every evaluation loads the base model in 4 4 -bit NF4 and applies each adapter as a low-rank adaptation module.
Open-book evaluation supplies the document with the training-time instruction template ( section B.1 ) without a chat template, at a window of 2048 2048 tokens that cuts no prompt, while closed-book evaluation withholds it; answers are generated greedily, up to 128 128 new tokens and with no repetition penalty, and scored by Stanford Question Answering Dataset token-level F 1 F_{1} ( Rajpurkar et al., 2016 ) over all four held-out items; section A.2 checks the metric against answer length.
Semantic distance between documents is one minus the cosine similarity of their all-mpnet-base-v2 sentence embeddings ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ; Sentence Transformers, 2021 ) .

blocks.en:
The cloze probe rewrites each held-out question-answering pair as a declarative sentence with one blank that the answer fills ( section B.2 ) and presents it without the document, so that filling it requires the fact from the weights in a surface form that no adapter was trained on.
The three factual items are scored by recall of the reference fill (an empty prediction scoring zero), and the true/false item is reported beside them.
Unlike the question-answering evaluations the cloze harness wraps each prompt in the model’s chat template, which no adapter saw in training but which enters every score and every reference alike; rerun in the training format on 35 35 documents, the chat wrapper raises the specialists’ cloze gain over the base model by + 0.057 +0.057 , a change whose confidence interval, [ − 0.069 , + 0.183 ] [$-0.069$,$+0.183$] , includes zero ( section A.3 ).

blocks.en: 7 Related work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en:
Parametric retrieval-augmented generation ( Su et al., 2025 ) trains one adapter per passage and, as re-implemented by Tang et al. (2025b) , sums the updates of those retrieved for a question; re-scored by answer presence, it does not consistently beat retrieval in context, and a generic question-answering adapter trained on 400 400 pooled examples, used as a control, leads the authors to conclude that its gains are mostly document-specific — a conclusion we reach, with a control drawn from the same population as the specialists ( section 4.2 ), only on the probe that withholds the document. Back et al. (2026) find routing among per-document adapters to be the main bottleneck, and Rakotonirina et al. (2026) , asking questions without the document, find that merged per-document adapters degrade as more documents are retrieved while the merges they compare lie within about one point of each other at five documents — which is consistent with our cloze grid ( section 5.4 ) and with how little the operator matters once scale is right ( section 5.2 ).
The reading behaviour of section 4 fits the account of Zhou et al. (2023) , in which instruction tuning mostly shapes how capability acquired in pre-training is expressed, and our training conditions ( section 3.1 ) are a document-level case of the finding of Allen-Zhu and Li (2024) that whether a fact can be extracted depends on how it is presented in training (further work in appendix G ).

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
On Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, open-book scoring mostly credits a reading behaviour every adapter shares: a random adapter recovers about four fifths of the specialists’ open-book advantage over the base model and 2 % 2\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of their cloze advantage, a share not distinguishable from zero.
At 16 16 documents or more, merges that recover 87 % to 89 % 87\text{\,}\mathrm{\%}89\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of the specialists’ open-book advantage recover 12 % to 16 % 12\text{\,}\mathrm{\%}16\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of their cloze advantage, each confidence interval including zero, against 94 % 94\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} for joint training: so open-book scores overstate how much of a document’s content survives merging or substitution.
Content does reach the weights, whose geometry records what each adapter read; yet in our bank that geometry did not pick out adapters that help with another document’s content on either probe, although with thirty queries the cloze confidence interval still admits an advantage of about four fifths of what a document’s own adapter gains over a random one.

blocks.en: Three recommendations follow: ( a ) score what an adapter holds with a probe that withholds the document, beside the open-book one; ( b ) measure against a random adapter averaged over several draws; and ( c ) evaluate specialists, base model, and composed adapters under one precision and decoding configuration, with one set of denominators per table. For a collection of up to 32 32 documents known in advance, joint training keeps what merges lose, at the cost of retraining whenever the collection changes.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Every result except the geometry rests on one base model, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, adapted at one rank and under one training schedule on 150 150 encyclopedic articles in six domains, so we cannot say how the shares of section 4 move with model size, adapter capacity, or genre; the effect of the training-length default on open-book scores was likewise measured on this model alone.
That schedule passes over each specialist’s eight training strings about a thousand times, with the loss over the whole string, most of whose tokens are the article; such a loss would lead one to expect that the geometry follows the text an adapter read ( section 3.3 ), and every adapter learns the shared template from the same repetition.
Composition was tested on collections fixed in advance and no larger than 32 32 documents, where joint training is not yet distinguishable from parity with the specialists ( section 5.3 ), so both the size at which a rank- 8 8 joint adapter stops keeping pace and the incremental case, in which composition would have to undercut retraining on each new document, remain untested.
blocks.zh:
除了几何学以外,每个结果都基于一个基础模型Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct,在一个级别下和在一个培训时间表下,在六个领域对150篇150篇百科全书文章进行了调整,因此我们不能说第4节的股份如何随模型大小,适配能力,或流派而移动;培训长度默认对开放书分的影响同样是仅用这个模型来衡量的.
该时间表将每个专家的8个训练弦相接了约一千次,损失超过整个弦,大部分符号是文章;这种损失将导致人们期望几何学遵循适配器读的文本(第3.3节),每个适配器从相同的重复中学习共享模板。
在预先确定的收集资料的基础上测试了组成情况,不超过32份32份文件,其中联合培训尚未与专家的同等程度区分开来(第5.3节),因此,8-8名联合适配器停止跟上速度的大小和增量情况(其中的组成必须削弱对每份新文件的再培训)仍然没有测试。

blocks.en:
Each document contributes three factual items and one true/false item, enough to estimate means over documents and collections but too few to characterize a single document; this is why the retrieval run cannot resolve content, since over its 30 30 queries even the specialist adapter is not distinguishable from the base model on cloze ( + 0.085 +0.085 with CI 95 % = [ , ] \mathrm{CI}_{$95\text{\,}\mathrm{\%}$}=[$$,$$] -0.011+0.189; section 4.3 ), and an advantage for weight-space selection of up to about four fifths of the own adapter’s margin over a random one remains possible.
The two probes also score different items, because cloze shares use the factual items alone, whereas open-book shares include the true/false item, on which the specialists score below the base model ( section A.2 ); since the items are generated by one model and validated only by string match against the source, a question that admits more than one answer, or a correct fill phrased differently, would go unrecognized, an error we did not measure.
blocks.zh:
每个文件都提供了三个事实项目和一个真实/假项目,足以估计文件和收藏手段,但太少,无法确定单一文件的特征;这就是为什么检索程序无法解决内容的原因,因为30多个问题,甚至专家适配器也无法与混凝土基准模型区分开来(+ 0.085+ 0.085, CI 95%= [,] mathrm{CI}_{95\text{\, + mathrm{\%} $ [$,] - 0.011+0.189;第4.3节),而且,在权重空间选择方面,仍然有可能保持大约五分之四的自适配器比随机差。
这两个探测器还得分不同的项目,因为块状股份单独使用事实项目,而开页股票则包括真/假项目,专家在其中的得分低于基准模型(A.2节);由于项目由一个模型产生,并且只能通过字符串匹配对源进行验证,一个接受不止一个答案的问题,或者一个不同的正确填充短语,都会不被认可,这个错误我们没有衡量.

blocks.en:
Wikipedia articles have probably been seen in pre-training, a criticism Rakotonirina et al. (2026) raise against evaluating parametric retrieval on such text, and our base model already reaches 0.81 0.81 of the specialists’ cloze recall over the composition grid’s rows ( section 4.2 ); every cloze result is stated against that base model, so what we measure is how adaptation changes the availability of facts the model may already hold, and whether a random adapter recovers as little of the cloze advantage on unseen documents is untested.
All our adapters also share one training format, the instruction template in which open-book evaluation presents the document ( section 2 ), so the four fifths that a random adapter recovers measure a behaviour our training instilled in every adapter alike; a bank of adapters trained in different formats might share less of it.
The base model, moreover, is scored open-book in that raw template rather than in its own chat template, so part of what every adapter adds may be adaptation to the format rather than to reading.
blocks.zh:
维基百科的文章可能出现在培训前, Rakotonirina 等人(2026年)对评估这些文字的参数检索提出了批评, 而我们的基础模型已经达到了0.81 0.81 0.81 位专家对组成网格行的血凝胶召回(第4.2节); 每一个血凝胶结果都与该基准模型相对照, 因此我们衡量的是, 适应如何改变模型可能已经掌握的事实, 以及随机适配器是否恢复在隐形文件上的血凝胶优势没有经过测试。
我们所有适配器也都使用一种训练格式,即开放式图书评价的教学模板(第2节),因此,随机适配器恢复的五分之四衡量我们在每个适配器中灌输的训练行为;以不同格式训练的适配器库可能分享较少。
此外,基准模型在原始模板中而不是在自己的聊天模板中打分,因此每个适配器增加的部分内容可能是适应格式而不是阅读。

blocks.en:
The retrieval bank never holds the query document’s own adapter, so that result bears on substituting one document’s adapter for another’s and says nothing about banks that hold every document’s adapter, as parametric retrieval-augmented generation does.
Our account of why the cross terms of section 5.2 cost little here and about ten points across eight vision tasks ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) — that updates sharing learned input directions let the cross terms re-add a common component — is a hypothesis we have not tested; on cloze, moreover, the merges keep so little of the specialists’ advantage at 16 16 documents or more that a cost of the cross terms would have little room to show.
blocks.zh:
检索银行从来不持有查询文件自己的适配器,因此其结果是将一个文件的适配器替换为另一个文件的适配器,并且对持有每个文件的适配器的银行一言不发,就像参数检索式的适配器生成一样。
我们说明为什么第5.2节的跨条款在这里花费很少,8项愿景任务(郑等人,2025年)花费大约10点,即更新分享学到的投入方向,让跨条款重新添加一个共同部分,这是我们尚未测试的一个假设;此外,合并在16份文件或更多文件中保留的专家优势很少,因此跨条款的成本没有多少余地显示。

blocks.en:
Two checks rest on less evidence than the main results: the footing of the archived 4 4 -bit composition numerators is inferred from the runner’s code and supported by 64 64 of the 66 66 evaluations they share with the retrieval run agreeing at six decimals ( section F.4 ), and the check on the chat wrapper rests on 35 35 documents, whose confidence interval on the change, [ − 0.069 , + 0.183 ] [$-0.069$,$+0.183$] , includes a change larger than the gain it checks ( section A.3 ).
The retrieval contrast is the only comparison whose decision criterion we fixed before computing it, and the other confidence intervals carry no correction for how many we computed, so a confidence interval that only just excludes zero carries little weight by itself.
A cell’s confidence interval in the composition grid, moreover, is resampled over only five collections, which share documents within and across cells, so it rests on few distinct resamples and will undercover; we therefore take the pooled contrasts as the evidence and the counts of cells whose confidence intervals exclude zero as description.
blocks.zh:
两项检查所依据的证据少于主要结果:从跑者代码中推断出存档的4 4-位组成数字的基础,在他们与检索程序共享的66项评价中,有64项64项支持(F.4节),关于聊天包的检查依据是35份文件,这些文件对变化的信心间隔[-0.069,+0.183] [0.069美元,+0.183美元],包括比检查所得更大的变化(A.3节)。
检索对比是唯一的比较,我们在计算它之前确定了它的决定标准,而其他的置信间隔对我们计算多少没有修正,因此仅仅排除零的置信间隔本身就没有什么重量了.
此外,一个细胞在组成网格中的信心间隔只被重新印在五个集合上,它们共享细胞内部和细胞之间的文件,因此它依赖于几个不同的复制品,并将卧底;因此,我们把集合的对比作为证据和那些其信心间隔排除0的细胞数作为描述。

Every document’s held-out set holds three factual questions and one true/false item, and the true/false item does not behave like the others: open-book the base model answers it correctly for 0.987 0.987 of documents and the natural adapter for 0.933 0.933 , so on all four items it narrows the specialists’ advantage rather than adding to it, while the swapped-context adapter, scored on its source document with its donor’s text in context, answers it correctly for only 0.413 0.413 , and closed-book every training condition answers it less often than the base model ( 0.520 to 0.673 0.5200.673 against 0.747 0.747 ).

blocks.en: A.3 Cloze harness

blocks.en:
Unlike the question-answering evaluations, the cloze harness wraps each prompt in the model’s chat template, which adds the template’s default system header and, through the tokenizer, a second beginning-of-sequence token; the wrapper is the same for every arm, the specialist and base-model references included.
Its length caps barely bind: prompts run from 60 60 to 108 108 tokens against a cap of 512 512 , and of the 900 900 cloze generations of the specialists and the base model, 8 8 reach the limit of 64 64 new tokens, all of them the specialists’, which can have lowered the specialists’ mean recall by at most 8 / 450 = 0.018 8/450=$0.018$ , since only a generation that was cut can lose its fill.
Because the adapters trained without a chat template, we reran 35 35 documents with the training-format prompt instead: under it the specialists return an empty answer on 14 14 of their 105 105 cloze items and the base model on none, which the records keep only as decoded strings, so what the specialists emitted in their place cannot be recovered, and the wrapper does not measurably change the specialists’ cloze gain over the base model: chat wrapper minus training format, the gain changes by + 0.057 +0.057 ( CI 95 % = [ , ] \mathrm{CI}_{$95\text{\,}\mathrm{\%}$}=[$$,$$] -0.069+0.183) with empty answers scored zero and by + 0.004 +0.004 ( CI 95 % = [ , ] \mathrm{CI}_{$95\text{\,}\mathrm{\%}$}=[$$,$$] -0.147+0.151) on the items both prompts answer, so the subset cannot exclude a change about the size of the gain in either direction.
Those documents are the 30 30 retrieval queries of section 4.3 and five chosen because their specialists recalled none of the factual items on the earlier footing, so their means are not the collection’s.

blocks.en: Appendix G Further related work
blocks.zh: 进一步的相关工作

blocks.en:
The closest work in framing is that of Back et al. (2026) , who train adapters per document and per chunk, route among them by text embedding and by token-level routers, merge the three highest-ranked, and score answers with a language-model judge, both closed-book and with retrieved text in context.
They measure how much a module stores and how routing and merging lose it, whereas we ask what the standard open-book probe measures and whether the geometry of the weights indexes content; their retrieval matches query text to documents, ours adapters to adapters.
With the ground-truth modules merged by trim, elect sign, and merge, their performance falls as the number merged grows from one to five, which is consistent with our cloze grid ( section 5.4 ), although probe, merge operator and metric all differ.

它们测量模块存储量和路由及合并方式的丢失程度,而我们则询问标准开放式书探查措施是什么以及加权索引内容的几何;它们的检索将查询文本与文档匹配,我们的适配器与适配器匹配。

blocks.en:
Gekhman et al. (2024) find that fine-tuning acquires new factual knowledge slowly and that doing so can increase hallucination.
Per-entity adapters trained on a knowledge graph store facts that, closed-book, only the entity’s own adapter recovers, and neither text embedding nor weight-space distance finds that adapter in a bank that holds it ( Pulici et al., 2026 ) ; our bank never holds the query’s own adapter and asks instead whether a neighbour’s can stand in, which on cloze it cannot detectably do ( section 4.3 ), and on open-book every adapter stands in about equally well ( section 4.1 ).
blocks.zh:
Gekhman等人(2024年)发现微调缓慢获得新的事实知识,这样做会增加幻觉.
接受过知识图表培训的实体适配器储存事实,即封闭式簿中,只有实体自己的适配器恢复,而且文本嵌入和重空距离都找不到适配器在持有它的银行中(Pulici等人,2026年);我们的银行从不持有查询自己的适配器,而是询问邻居是否可以站立起来,在混凝土上它无法察觉到这一点(第4.3节),在开放式簿中,每个适配器都处于同样好的状态(第4.1节)。

blocks.en:
Document adapters are close to the most favourable case for the interference that merging methods address, since their updates are nearly orthogonal layer by layer ( section 3 ), and neither semantic nor weight-space distance anticipates what a trim, elect sign, and merge merge of two adapters costs ( section E.5 ).
KnOTS ( Stoica et al., 2025 ) and Core Space merging ( Panariello et al., 2025 ) merge full updates into an adapter whose rank may exceed that of its parts, so neither offers a matched-rank comparison for our merges, and section F.2 sets the 1 / N 2 1/N^{2} scale of factor averaging against the rescaling of Back et al. (2026) and LoRA- Lego ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) .

文档适配器接近合并方法所处理的干扰的最有利情况,因为它们的更新几乎是逐层的正交层(第3节),而且语义和重量-空间距离都不能预见到什么是修剪、选举标志和合并两个适配器的费用(第E.5节)。
枪声 (Stoica等人,2025年)和Core Space合并(Panariello等人,2025年)将全部更新合并成一个适配器,其级别可能超过其各部分,因此两者都无法对我们的合并进行相应的排名比较,F.2节规定了Back等人(2026年)和Lora-Lego(赵等人,2025年)的调整平均系数表。
